mapper.select: SELECT CAST(d.payload AS CHAR) FROM fcc_screen_pop_delivery d JOIN fcc_call_session c ON c.id=d.call_id AND c.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND d.owner_work_no=#{owner} AND d.closed_at IS NULL AND d.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND c.ended_at IS NULL AND c.answered_at IS NULL AND c.primary_work_no=#{owner} ORDER BY d.expires_at LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE fcc_screen_pop_delivery SET received_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='RECEIVED' THEN COALESCE(received_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE received_at END, shown_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='SHOWN' THEN COALESCE(shown_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE shown_at END, activated_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='ACTIVATED' THEN COALESCE(activated_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE activated_at END, unsupported_at=CASE WHEN #{state}='UNSUPPORTED' THEN COALESCE(unsupported_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ELSE unsupported_at END WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} AND call_id=#{call}
UPDATE fcc_screen_pop_delivery SET closed_at=COALESCE(closed_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_work_no=#{owner} AND call_id=#{call}
